source_provider: Purdue University Archives and Special Collections
source_date: The image was published with a Purdue Archives article dated 2016-12-01; capture date and photographer are not stated.
observation_method: Visual inspection of Purdue Archives exterior photograph. No orthorectification or scale calibration performed.
observations: Two major above-grade window rows are visible on the photographed wings.
A higher entrance/lobby tower rises above the lower flat parapet roof.
The entrance tower combines brick, a pale stone vertical panel, tall glazing, and a vertical sign panel.
The west-facing/recessed entrance has tall glazing and a shallow light-colored canopy.
Red brick, pale horizontal stone bands, and a flat roof/parapet are visible across the photographed facades.
limitations: The photograph is oblique and covers only a portion of the building; it does not establish the unseen facades or geographic orientation.
No calibrated dimensions, elevation, section, or survey data are included.
The tower dimensions and precise placement in the model remain estimates.
